description: oemof-B3 optimises a multi-node energy system for Berlin and Brandenburg across electricity, heat, hydrogen, methane and carbon dioxide. It minimises cost with perfect foresight and links regions through transmission. The provider is rl-institut (repository owner). Coverage: Six published scenarios target 2050 with different emission reductions and degrees of electrification. These are model scenarios for Berlin and Brandenburg, Germany. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The repository identifies AGPL version 3. Underlying data and dependencies have separate conditions. Limitations: The README recommends Python 3.8 to 3.10 and warns about newer-version installation. The scenarios do not establish realised infrastructure or unique forecasts. For simulation it supports regional decarbonisation comparisons. Related resources: The model explicitly builds on oemof.solph and related packages; model-oemof-solph is the parent framework, not this regional study model.
